blocker.type: priority-year cursor drift plus broad-index gateway failure
blocker.observed_execution: The workflow labelled as the overriding 2013 priority probe actually consumed archival_url_last_processed and retried snapshot_year 2012 because the deep cursor had already advanced below 2013.
exact_failures: CC-MAIN-2012 auctions.savills.co.uk :: HTTPError: HTTP Error 504: Gateway Time-out
CC-MAIN-2012 www.savills.co.uk :: HTTPError: HTTP Error 504: Gateway Time-out
blocker.useful_2012_observation: The savills.co.uk domain query returned 13,793 raw index rows but only one auction-path candidate, http://www.savills.co.uk/auctions/resicatrequest/PreRegistration.aspx, whose live HTTPS Savills URL now returns 404 and therefore was correctly rejected as evidence.

changes: The Common Crawl retry now enumerates the exact collection IDs returned by Common Crawl for the requested year; for 2013 these are expected to include CC-MAIN-2013-48 and CC-MAIN-2013-20 rather than a synthesized collection name.
It probes compact first-party Savills auction path prefixes with matchType=prefix before any broad domain fallback, reducing legacy index gateway timeouts.
The workflow now always runs an explicit --year 2013 priority probe while allowing the independent deeper archival cursor to continue into 2012, 2011 and earlier years.
Validation now asserts that the Common Crawl priority probe actually executed snapshot_year 2013 before publication.
All archive/index URLs remain discovery-only; a candidate still requires surviving live Savills UK first-party evidence before History V2 ingestion.
